intent.problem: Work passed every check, yet a customer still found a bug: the checks only looked at some kinds of mistake.
intent.move: Each gate checks a different kind of thing; every miss becomes a new kind of check.
intent.belief: Machines check every run; misses become new checks; passing is not quality.

unclear: Check it at the gate. (what is 'it')
Fold the miss into a new check.

why: All three got the problem and the move (gist 'every miss becomes a new check'), but every persona quoted on-screen words as unclear, and none could say what the gates check or who the whale/fish are; the colour abstraction was lost. Confidence on the fix 5-6/10.
lessons: Name the actors on screen once (your work, the customer, the checker).
Write what each gate checks under its icon in plain words.
Make the abstract property concrete (the page used the wrong font), not 'colour'.
No internal source names on cards ('our own error log', not 'Limits & escapes register').
Avoid run, fold, register, escape, vague 'here'.
Say once what the work is in everyday terms.
